chapter_seo_title: The Talisman's Blood-Sweat: Li Huowang Tests a New Power | Chapter 317
chapter_meta_description: Li Huowang puts a dark talisman to the test, extracting a brutal speed boost from a sweating horse. He then probes a local peddler for news of the next horror zone in Cangshui County.
og_title: Wait, Did He Just... Make the Horse Bleed For Speed?!
og_description: Li Huowang tests a new talisman that delivers a terrifying power-up with a messy price tag, then haggles for info with a peddler whose ghost story is a little too convenient.
twitter_title: Li Huowang discovers a new talisman is basically a "go fast, bleed now" button.
twitter_description: New chapter insight: Li Huowang experiments with a talisman and immediately learns there's no such thing as a free lunch in the Dao-Twisted World.

lore_anchors.definition: Visual patterns—derived from insect trails, star markings, and natural phenomena—that are used to channel Heaven-and-Earth's spiritual energy.
Sounds and incantations imitating bird calls and animal cries, used to mobilize spiritual energy; often paired with a talisman script.
Three internal parasitic demons in Daoist belief, residing in the head, chest, and belly; they seek to hasten death and report a person's misdeeds to Heaven.
A traditional Chinese festival on the 15th day of the seventh lunar month, when the gates of the underworld are opened to allow spirits to visit the living world.
Ranks within the Supervisory Heavenly Office; Gui is a lower rank, while Ren Wu is a higher grade, indicating a significant promotion.
